options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: bundle_file_locator
options.description: the path of lcm bundle on vxm, which is recommended under /data/store2

options.name: enable_quick_boot
options.description: Enable quick boot to reduce reboot time.

options.name: enforce_quick_patch
options.description: Enable quick patch to apply patches without VM evacuation or host reboot.

options.name: health_precheck_type
options.description: The type of health pre-check to be run. Supported values are LCM_PRECHECK.

options.name: parallel_remediation_enable
options.description: Enable parallel remediation. For Dynamic Node only

options.name: parallel_remediation_max
options.description: Assign the maximum number of hosts to enter maintenance mode at a time and perform remediation.

options.name: retry_as_standard
options.description: Enable retry as standard to disable live patch and retry upgrade automatically.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for LCM Upgrade, the default value is 21600 seconds

options.name: vc_root_account
options.description: root account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vc_root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in vcroot

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxm_root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in vxm

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
